verdict.rationale: Secureframe has dedicated framework pages for HIPAA (policy setup, employee/vendor/asset management), GDPR (cloud configuration checks), and PCI DSS (certification streamlining), alongside SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and NIST 800-171. It also states that each supported framework includes control mapping and automated control testing from integrated tools, which indicates one platform rather than separate tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and deeper per-framework documentation (the GDPR and HIPAA pages are thin marketing claims) showing how controls are shared across frameworks.
